description: Schéma directeur des Infrastructures de recharges pour véhicules électriques - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Afin d’accélérer le déploiement des IRVE ouvertes au public et d’en assurer la cohérence territoriale, l’article 68 de la loi d’orientation des mobilités prévoit la possibilité, pour les collectivités ou établissements publics, de réaliser un schéma directeur de développement des IRVE. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Réseaux/Energie. Its keywords are IRVE, Borne, électrique, véhicule, voiture. The portal shows 57 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
